g.text: Proposed gas-space geometry • dimensions in mm • no CFD results

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a35413

g.text: BLUE: reported dimensions AMBER / dashed: assumptions or derived positions

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243646

g.text: 4 × Ø4.8 on Ø32 pitch circle; Ø50 wafer inside Ø66 support.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243646

g.text: Projection combines different heights; only two tubes intersect y = 0.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a35413

g.text: 2 × Ø16 nominal; centres (±35, 0) are our assumption.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a35413

g.text: Outlet direction: downward. Port lengths assumed to be 10 mm.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a35413

g.text: * Coordinates use an estimated 1 mm junction gap and a proposed simplified support stack.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243646

g.text: Grey regions are solid exclusions. Green marks the wafer; dotted purple marks the proposed sampling height.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243646

g.text: Lower support placement and exhaust geometry need sensitivity review. Diagnostic ports, heaters and bellows detail are omitted.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243646

g.text: Reference: Kimes, Moore & Maslar, Rev. Sci. Instrum. 83, 083106 (2012), Section II / Figs. 1–4. This is not their CAD or a mesh.
